# Errors

Methods are `async` and surface failure by throwing — the return type only
describes the success value. A thrown `BoxApiError` is either a transport
failure or a non-2xx response after the network layer's retries (exponential
backoff + jitter, `401` refresh, `Retry-After`). For a non-2xx response it
carries the HTTP `status`, Box's error `code`, `boxMessage`, and `requestId`,
and the raw `body`; transport and decode failures carry the underlying
`cause` instead:

```ts
import { runtime } from '@unofficialbox/box-open-sdk';
try {
  await client.files.get(fileId);
} catch (err) {
  if (err instanceof runtime.BoxApiError) {
    // err.status, err.code, err.boxMessage, err.requestId, err.body, err.cause
  }
}
```

## Etags: `If-None-Match` and `If-Match`

Files and folders carry an `etag`. Send it back to stay in sync with Box
(Box's [Ensure consistency](https://developer.box.com/guides/api-calls/ensure-consistency/)
guide):

- **Reads** — a file or folder `get`, and each shared-item lookup, has an
  `…IfModified` variant that takes the stored etag, sends it as
  `If-None-Match`, and returns `undefined` when Box answers `304 Not Modified`:
  keep your cached copy. (The plain method surfaces that 304 as the error
  above if you set `if-none-match` on it yourself.)
- **Writes** — pass the etag as `'if-match'` on a file or folder update or
  delete, or a new file version upload. Box answers `412 Precondition
  Failed` (code `precondition_failed`) when the item changed since you read
  it, and `runtime.isPreconditionFailed(err)` reports it: read it again,
  reapply your change, retry. `If-Match` can't block a move.

```ts
const file = await client.files.getIfModified(fileId, etag);
if (file === undefined) {
  // unchanged since etag
}

// Re-read and retry: the update lands only on the version it was made from.
for (let attempt = 1; ; attempt++) {
  try {
    await client.files.update(fileId, body, { 'if-match': etag });
    break;
  } catch (err) {
    if (!runtime.isPreconditionFailed(err) || attempt === 3) throw err;
    const current = await client.files.get(fileId);
    etag = current.etag ?? undefined; // reapply your change to current here
  }
}
```
